name: Project World Impact
author: Ben Clarke

sections.description:
Our WordPress plugin empowers Project World Impact nonprofit partners to enhance their websites by seamlessly integrating PWI Crowdfund projects, PWI GroupGiving projects, and PWI Storyteller submissions. With this plugin, you can easily showcase your fundraising efforts, engage your community, and share impactful stories. Designed for ease of use and maximum flexibility, the plugin provides customizable options to fit the unique needs of each nonprofit, making it a vital tool for driving donations and building connections through your WordPress site.

The plugin also features Google Tag Manager integration, allowing you to track user interactions and measure the effectiveness of your campaigns with detailed analytics and conversion tracking. This provides valuable insights into donor behavior and helps optimize your fundraising strategies.

External Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on the use of third-party services to fetch and display project data, as well as analytics tracking. By using this plugin, you agree to the transmission of data to and from these services.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under Settings -> PWI.

That’s it! You’re ready to go.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the appearance of the project display?

Yes, the plugin provides basic styling, which can be further customized using the plugin settings or your theme’s styles.

Is there a limit to the number of projects I can display?

No, you can display an unlimited number of projects.

Do I need a Project World Impact account to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin is designed for our partners to embed projects on their own websites. Signing up for an account is quick and easy. Visit projectworldimpact.com/dashboard/crowdfund or projectworldimpact.com/dashboard/groupgive to learn more.
